# DhanHQ API v2 Reference Library

- Source: Official DhanHQ API v2 documentation
- Documentation portal: https://docs.dhanhq.co/api/v2/
- Reference collection date: 13 November 2026

## Preserved documents

| Document | Scope |
|---|---|
| Dhan_Data_API_OHLC.pdf | OHLC data API |
| Dhan_DHAN_ANNEX.pdf | API annexure, codes and enumerations |
| Dhan_Historical_Data.pdf | Historical market data |
| Dhan_Instruments_Guide.pdf | Instrument master and identifiers |
| Dhan_Live_Market_Feed.pdf | Live market feed |
| Dhan_MARKET_ANALYTICS.pdf | Market analytics |

## Governance and interpretation

These files are preserved reference documents for technical assessment.
Their presence does not establish account entitlement, subscription status,
live API availability, or successful production access.

Publication does not grant implementation authority, authorize vendor API
requests, change W-06 status, or alter existing governance decisions.

Any inconsistencies between documents must be investigated and recorded
rather than silently reconciled.
